study: Full-source retrospective calibration and rolling temporal robustness

base_model_contract.name: Historical LightGBM500 family, newly fitted version; not historical v2 weights
base_model_contract.feature_policy: Same numeric/categorical candidate families incl V1-V339; V missingness <=0.95 and ordinal vocabularies learned on each core only

development.selection_rule: Lowest unweighted mean Brier across three pre-final validation windows; alphabetic tie-break

uncertainty.method: paired relative-day cluster percentile bootstrap, conditional on fixed fitted model
uncertainty.limitation: Does not capture model-fit or masked-customer cluster uncertainty; time blocks may remain dependent.

score_contract.risk_score: Uncalibrated rank score from the new versioned LightGBM500 fit
score_contract.calibrated_fraud_probability: platt transform fitted on the disjoint middle window of this model version only
score_contract.scope: retrospective IEEE-CIS historical research; aggregate report only

limitations: IEEE-CIS is already explored historical data; final is isolated within this execution, not a pristine prospective/external cohort.
Masked features and TransactionDT are proxies/relative time, not real identity or calendar dates.
New fold-fit preprocessing and 60/20/20 fit contract prevent attaching this calibration to historical v2 weights.
Three rolling windows and relative-day intervals do not prove robustness to all future shifts.
No customer blocking, prevented-loss or production deployment effectiveness claim.
